channel.title: Media and entertainment: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the media and entertainment sector.

item.title: Ascendio: Ascendio signed a cosmetics supply contract worth KRW 906.4m, equal to 15.31% of recent revenue, with an overseas distributor.
Ascendio: Ascendio signed a cosmetics supply contract worth KRW 929.9m with a global beauty distributor, equal to 15.70% of recent revenue.
Copus Korea: Korea Exchange will decide by December 4, 2026 whether Copus Korea is subject to a substantive listing eligibility review.
CJ CGV: CJ CGV reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 688.1bn and operating profit of KRW 73.6bn, both up year on year.
